name: Dura-Ace press-fit bottom bracket
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 54 g for the exact SM-BB92-41B HOLLOWTECH II press-fit bottom-bracket assembly, separately identified from SM-BB9000 threaded cups. The weighed shell configuration is not further specified.
